Title: Await all the way down
Body: Make the whole call chain async and `await` it. Mixing blocking calls (`.Result`) into async code is the classic source of thread-pool starvation and deadlocks.

Title: Turn on nullable reference types
Body: Enable `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>` and treat warnings seriously. It finds a whole class of bugs at compile time.

Title: Use AsNoTracking for read-only queries
Body: EF Core tracks every entity it loads. For queries that only display data, `AsNoTracking()` cuts memory and CPU noticeably.

Title: Register services with the right lifetime
Body: Scoped for per-request state (DbContext), singleton only for thread-safe shared state, transient for light stateless helpers. A singleton holding a scoped service is a bug.

Title: Keep secrets out of source control
Body: Use user secrets in development and environment variables or a vault in production. Never commit connection strings or API keys.
